name: Aimil Ltd
india_angle: Aimil Ltd. has a strong presence in India with an extensive network of 16 offices and over 1000 professionals, focusing on delivering advanced technology solutions to the Indian market.
summary: Aimil Ltd. is a prominent player in the instrumentation industry, providing advanced equipment and solutions for semiconductor manufacturing, including contamination monitoring and plasma processing systems. The company leverages partnerships with international firms to bring state-of-the-art technology to the Indian semiconductor market.
